deterministic_product_logic.claim: Deterministic logic is limited to fixture loading, timestamp staging, ACL packet bounds, schema checks, append-only evidence ref validation, and artifact serialization; it does not choose story meaning.
deterministic_product_logic.seed_authoring_rule: May cite only inputs observed before 2026-05-12T00:00:00-07:00.
deterministic_product_logic.second_authoring_rule: May cite only inputs observed at or after 2026-05-12T00:00:00-07:00 plus already committed prior context when needed.

story_decision_role_provenance.record_shape: Each story_decisions record is a combined-role recorded agent output. The source agent response chose both story identity and advancement/contradiction treatment from the same ACL-bounded packet; deterministic harness code may materialize those choices but may not split an unprovenanced record into extra roles.

roles.recorded_choice: changed_facts, conflicts, confidence, uncertainty handling implied by classification

bullets: Harbor ferry story changed from active strike disruption to a corrected/resolved state, with repeated reports preserved as pressure and contradiction rather than collapsed.
The terminal cafe walkout is adjacent to the ferry story but distinct because ferry crossings stayed normal while cafe workers walked out.
For Flynn privately, roof repair is waiting on HOA approval after quote-measurement progress, and the basement humidity sensor remains worth surfacing only because Flynn asked to watch it.
Roof repair is no longer just waiting on line items: the quote arrived at 14800, with same-week installation available if Flynn approves tonight.
The later harbor ferry item does not reopen the strike; it only confirms a quiet resolved state with no new filings, so it should not repeat seed briefing facts as new.
Second-pass authoring updates private seen-state for the roof decision and records the ferry item as stale/no-material-change context.
